propositions: _translate_findings flattens verdict[blocking] and verdict[advisory] into a single list, losing information about which bucket each finding originated from via a dead-weight severity field that nothing reads
CLI renderers _render_review_text and _render_plan_review_text print severity words for code-review findings that now carry decision field, but should print BLOCKING/ADVISORY instead

_render_review_text must handle two producer paths: code-review findings with decision field (print decision-derived blocking/advisory) and spec-scan findings without decision field (print existing severity fallback)
_render_plan_review_text advisory branch prints sev= suffix inconsistently with its blocking branch, which omits per-finding severity tags
review_bot/finding_publish.py already conveys blocking/advisory structurally via bucket batching and requires no changes to satisfy human-facing design
